verdict.rationale: Viam ships an official CLI that can call any machine API method with JSON in and JSON out and no code required. Its docs explicitly say an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person or program can, which covers headless, scriptable automation. CLI data-query and fleet-management commands, plus Python, Go, and TypeScript SDKs, extend this to non-interactive workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, documented non-interactive auth for pipelines (e.g. API keys or service accounts), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
